verdict.rationale: Paddle documents payout reconciliation reports that tie payouts to the underlying transactions and adjustments. They verify payout totals against remittance advice by summing balance movements, and they itemize gross, taxes, Paddle fees, chargeback fees, and retained fees in both transaction and balance currencies. The reports can also be generated via API to feed accounting systems. Missing for 10: explicit itemization of refunds (only implied through 'adjustments'), direct matching to bank deposits rather than to remittance advice, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
